text:
Beg her? Be scorned? Love her? Follow her? Defend herself? Seize her? Grow angry? Desire and not desire? Let herself be touched, then resist persuasion?


Hold her? Try to break away? Wrestle in her arms? Kiss her unwilling, have her take offense? Fail to leave?


Have her insult me, reprove my pleasure, then abandon her frown and show no displeasure?


Consent to moving her shift, find it clean and fit it neatly? This is love; all else is laughter.

translation.title: Definition of Love
